correctness.rationale: PASS. From the exact ordinary 3×5 board with capacities 2 in every row and column, independent combination-based enumeration gives 3,480 nonempty simplices with face vector (15,105,420,990,1260,690). Stagewise toggle matching yields 1,694 disjoint pairs and critical cells exactly one 0-simplex plus ninety-one 5-simplices. Independently reconstructed every one of 15,870 Morse-directed codimension-one incidences and exact topological sort of all 3,480 simplices in /mnt/data/scope08_independent_20261015.py. Therefore Forman gives one 0-cell and 91 5-cells with no positive lower skeleton: the integral homotopy type is wedge^91 S5. Source secondary GF2 boundary ranks (14,91,329,661,599) corroborate but are not relied on for integral homotopy.

originality.rationale: PASS under strongest plausible coverage. Wachs 2003 §7 and Reiner–Roberts Theorem 7.1 cover exactly the bounded-degree bipartite complex Delta_{(2,2,2),(2,2,2,2,2)} with a rational characteristic-zero homology representation/Betti formula, so number 91 and degree 5 are anticipated; they do not give a complete acyclic matching or explicitly determine this integral homotopy type, and the representation-theoretic formula does not automatically rule out integral torsion. Wachs §7.3 Problem 7.10 asks for missing bipartite homotopy analogues. Published M2(K3,4) and M2(K4,4) are different boards; Singh n−1 square-board results do not include 3×5. This precise integral wedge upgrade survives, with the existing rational rank plainly not presented as new.
residual_risks: Earlier representation-theoretic formulas may extend to integral coefficients via another result not inspected and combine with connectivity to imply the wedge; such a stronger equivalence was not established from the checked primary text.
Source scripts were separately read and compared to independent enumeration; upper-dimensional integral homotopy claim rests on complete exact acyclicity, not GF2 ranks.
